'''Bootana Shagplan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> located in the [[Bootana Shagplan system/Legends|Bootana Shagplan system]], a part of the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' area in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. It was connected by a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Elgit system/Legends|Elgit]] and [[Langoona system/Legends|Langoona systems]]<ref name="TEA" /> and shared its name with the [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] words "bootana" and "shag," which meant "[[Garden/Legends|garden]]"<ref name="LoNH" /> and "slave," respectively.<ref name="Phrasebook">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>

Bootana Shagplan served as a clearinghouse for luxury goods that were being transported to the ''Bootana Hutta''{{'s}} [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworlds]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clans]]. It was also the site of the most exclusive market of [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] people in the ''Bootana Hutta''. Many of the individuals who were the most expensive and sought after by the Hutts were sold at Bootana Shagplan. Those people were considered worthy enough to be allowed into the ''Bootana Hutta''.<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bootana Shagplan was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-10.<ref name="TEA" />
